Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap: CloudPay is looking to reduce token costs on high-throughput billing generation, get predictable latency under 150ms p95 for interactive agent workflows, and have a private deployment option for sensitive PII.

Next step: we'd love to schedule a 30-minute intro demo to show the Redwood runtime, routing/fallbacks, and batching impact on costs. Can you confirm which of these slots works for your team (all times PST):

- Option A: Wed Feb 11, 10:00–10:30 AM PST — product + quick Q&A
- Option B: Thu Feb 12, 2:00–2:30 PM PST — includes a short technical deep dive (engineer-friendly)
- Option C: Fri Feb 13, 11:00–11:30 AM PST — earlier slot for US East folks

Suggested attendees: Jordan + Sanjay (lead engineer) + procurement (for initial SOW/terms questions). From our side I'll include Aditya (deployment lead) and Marissa (solutions engineer).

If none of these work, happy to share a Calendly link or coordinate alternatives. Also attaching a short list of pre-demo questions so we can tailor the technical portion.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
